technology_boundaries: Browser IndexedDB data is tied to a browser profile, not cross-device shared storage.

126B Omni and 732m SUPERNODES are separate logical namespace counts; they do not count live agents or servers.
Merged source code does not imply passing CI or production readiness.
Do not publish private originals, credentials, precise locations or private family records in a public repository.

sync.privacy_rule: Do not include private case, child or medical details in public or example exports.

process.name: CERO SOURCE
process.action: Import original narrative, four mechanisms and 101 sayings; hash, freeze and version without rewriting

process.name: UNO CLASSIFY
process.action: Tag incentive mechanism, scripture cross-reference, source type, attribution and exception flags

process.name: DOS ANALYZE
process.action: Build stakeholder maps, testable hypotheses, evidence/counterevidence and funding/hand-off chain

process.name: BUILD
process.action: Generate source-backed lessons, case studies, report cards and issue registers with owner approval

process.name: CLEAR
process.action: Remove unsupported derived allegations or duplicate work items without deleting original evidence

process.name: EXPORT
process.action: Generate reviewed portable JSON packet and ZIP archive with manifest hashes

process.name: RESTORE
process.action: Validate exact recovery across another browser profile/device before considering sync dependable

safety_rules.1+1=2: BUILD is context-sensitive: creation may construct a tool whose purpose is authorized clearing
safety_rules.1-1=0: CLEAR removes selected derived or working material, never automatically destroys originals
safety_rules.help_first: Prioritize immediate protection, especially for children and other vulnerable persons, with lawful reporting and preservation of evidence
safety_rules.due_process: Accusation is not proof; do not automatically infer motive from outcome or quote
safety_rules.scope: No live surveillance, institutional access, cloud sync or automatic AI-provider sync is installed by this standalone artifact.
